title: Shadow Copy
pitch: Film a job once; it becomes an illustrated SOP, a trainee quiz, and a live watcher that catches missed steps
problem: In every trade and factory, the real procedure lives in one expert's hands. When they retire, quit or take leave, quality walks out with them — new hires relearn by breaking things, and nobody can prove a job was done right.
how: Phone records the expert doing the job once. Spark 1.3 (video) segments the take into steps; Voice Transcribe lifts the narration; SAM 3.1 segments tools/parts per step; Muse Image renders clean step cards; Spark writes the checkpoint list and trainee quiz. Live mode: a tripod phone + SAM 3.1 (Glimmer at the edge) ticks off steps in real time and flags skips before sign-off.
demo: Film the presenter making pour-over coffee. 60 seconds later the SOP appears with step cards. Then the presenter does it WRONG (skips the rinse); the live watcher flags the skipped step with a red overlay before the cup is done.
